entities.name: Radivoj Korać
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Radivoj Korać was a Serbian and Yugoslav professional basketball player. He represented the Yugoslavia national basketball team internationally. Korać is well-known for holding the EuroLeague's all-time single-game scoring record, at 99 points scored, in a game versus Alviks Stockholm, during the 1964–65 season, and for once making 100 out of 100 free throws on a live television show in Belgium.
